a: Im hikpid alav — in, i la — la.

Ezehu rok tafel. tana: kol shello taam kelum mibbaerev. sevar rav pappa kammeh derava lememar, keman deamar la team midde beureta. amar leh rava: mi katane "baerev"? "mibbaerev" katane, leappoke hecha dekadem veachel.

Amar rabba bar bar channa, amar rabbi yochanan: ezehu rok tafel? kol sheavar alav chatzot layla uveshena. lememra divshena talya milleta? vehatnan: yashan kol hayyom — en ze rok tafel, neor kol hallayla — hare ze rok tafel! hatam bemitnamnem.
Hechi dame mitnamnem? amar rav ashe: nim vela nim, tir vela tir, dekaru leh — veane, vela yada leahdore sevara, vechi madkeru leh — middechar.
Tana: hishkim veshana pirko — en ze rok tafel. vead kamma? amar rav yehuda bar shela, amar rav ashe, amar rabbi elazar: kol sheyyatza rov dibburo shel shalosh shaot.
Me gerisin — leissat gerisin shel pol vechulei. lema mesayyay leh leresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: rok tafel tzarich sheyyehe im kol echad veechad? dilma havela defumma mealle.
Matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda, detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: me gerisin roteach, veover sheyyitten letocho melach.

May mashma dehay "over" lishshana deakdome hu? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: deamar kera "vayyarotz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et hakkushi". abbaye amar: mehacha "vehu avar lifnehem", veibbaet ema mehacha: "vayyaavor malkam lifnehem vaAdonai berosham".
Me raglayim shehechmitzu. tana: kamma chimmutzan? — shelosha yamim.
Amar rabbi yochanan: kol shiure chachamim bichtamim — tzarich shiur leshiuran. deyeled o dezaken, deish o deishsha, mechussim o megullim, bimot hachamma o bimot haggeshamim.
Vetzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim. bae rabbi yirmeya: amtoye veetoye chad, o dilma amtoye veetoye tarte? may? teku.
Heeviran shello kesidran. tanu rabbanan: hikdim sheniyyim larishonim, tane chada: sheniyyim alu lo, rishonim lo alu lo. vetanya iddach: rishonim alu lo, sheniyyim lo alu lo.
Amar abbaye: idi veidi sheniyyim alu lo, velo rishonim, umay "rishonim"? rishonim lichsidran, usheniyyim lehaavaratan.

Mishna kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset — dayyah sheatah. veellu hen havvesatot: mefaheket, umeatteshet, vechosheshet befi cheresah, uveshippule meeha, veshofaat, uchemin tzemarmorot ochazin otah, vechen kayyotze bahen. vechol shekkava lah shalosh peamim — hare ze veset.
Gemara tenena chada zimna: kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset dayyah sheatah! hatam — bivsatot deyome, hacha — bivsatot degufa.
Kidkatane: ellu hen vesatot — hayta mefaheket, meatteshet, vechosheshet befi cheresah, uveshippule meeha, veshofaat.
Shofaat? ha shafa veazla! amar ulla bereh derav illay:
b: Beshofaat dam tame mittoch dam tahor.
Uchemin tzemarmorot vechulei. "vechen kayyotze bahen" — leetoye may? amar rabba bar ulla: leetoye ishsha sheroshah kaved aleha, veevareha kevedim aleha, verotetet, vegosa.
Amar rav huna bar chiyyay, amar shemuel: hare amru leyamim — shenayim, livsatot — achat, lema shello manu chachamim — shelosha.

Lema shello manu chachamim. leetoye may? amar rav yosef: leetoye roshah kaved aleha, veevareha kevedin aleha, verotetet, vegosa. amar leh abbaye: may ka mashma lan? matnitin hi! deha parsha rabba bar ulla. ella amar abbaye: leetoye achla shum veraata, veachla betzalim veraata, kassa pilpelim veraata.
Amar rav yosef: la shemia li ha shemata.

Amar leh abbaye: at amrita nihalan, veaha amrita nihalan — hayta lemuda lihyot roa yom chamishsha asar, veshinneta leyom esrim — ze veze asurin. shalosh peamim leyom esrim — huttar yom chamishsha asar, vekava lah yom esrim, sheen ishsha kovaat lah veset ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim.
Vaamart lan ala, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre rabban gamliel bar rabbi, sheamar mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel, aval chachamim omrim: raata — enah tzericha lo lishnot velo leshallesh.
Veamrinan lach: lishnot amrat lan, leshallesh mibbaya? vaamart lan: lishnot — bivsatot, leshallesh — beyamim.
Venema: zo divre rabban shimon ben gamliel! ha ka mashma lan shemuel, derabban gamliel berabbi kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira leh.
Mishna hayta lemuda lihyot roa bitchillat havvesatot — kol hatteharot sheasta betoch havvesatot temeot. besof havvesatot — kol hatteharot sheasta betoch havvesatot tehorot.
Rabbi yose omer: af yamim veshaot vesatot. hayta lemuda lihyot roa im hanetz hachamma — enah asura ella im hanetz hachamma. rabbi yehuda omer: kol hayyom shellah.

Gemara tana: ketzad amar rabbi yose yamim veshaot vesatot? hayta lemuda lihyot roa miyyom esrim leyom esrim, umishshesh shaot leshesh shaot. higgia yom esrim velo raata — asura leshammesh kol shesh shaot rishonot, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose mattir ad shesh shaot, vechosheshet beshesh shaot.
Avru shesh shaot, velo raata — asura leshammesh kol hayyom kullo, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose mattir min hammincha ulemala.
Hayta lemuda. vehatanya: rabbi yehuda omer: kol hallayla shellah!
La kashya — ha dirgila lirot bitchillat yemama, veha dirgila lirot besof lelya.
Tane chada: rabbi yehuda osrah lifne vistah, umattirah leachar vistah. vetanya iddach: osrah leachar vistah, umattirah lifne vistah.
Vela kashya — ha dirgila lemichze besof lelya, ha dirgila lemichze bitchillat yemama.

Amar rava: halacha kerabbi yehuda, umi amar rava hachi? vehatanya: "vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumeatam" — mikkan amar rabbi yirmeya: azhara livne yisrael sheyyifreshu minneshotehen samuch levistan.
Vechamma? amar rava: ona. may lav ona achariti? la, otah ona.
Vetarte lema li? tzericha, dei ashmoinan ha — hava amena hane mille litharot, aval levalah — la. ka mashma lan.
Vei mehahi — hava amena "samuch levistah" ona achariti. ka mashma lan otah ona.
Mishna hayta lemuda lihyot roa yom chamishsha asar, veshinneta lihyot roa leyom esrim — ze vaze asurin. shinneta paamayim leyom esrim — ze vaze asurin.

Shinneta shalosh peamim leyom esrim — huttar chamishsha asar, vekava lah yom esrim, sheen ishsha kovaat lah veset ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim, veenah mittaheret min havveset ad shetteaker mimmenna shalosh peamim.

a: Gemara ittemar, raata yom chamishsha asar lechodesh ze, veyom shishsha asar lechodesh ze, veyom shiva asar lechodesh ze — rav amar: kava lah veset ledillug, ushemuel amar: ad shetteshallesh bedillug.

Nema rav ushemuel biflugeta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel kamippalgi, detanya: nisset larishon vamet, lashsheni vamet — lashshelishi lo tinnase, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lashshelishi tinnase, larvii lo tinnase.
La, dechulle alma kerabban shimon ben gamliel, vehacha beha kamippalgi: rav savar chamishsha asar mimminyana, ushemuel savar kevan delav bedillug chazeteh — lav mimminyana hu.
Etiveh: hayta lemuda lihyot roa yom chamishsha asar, veshinneta leyom shishsha asar — ze vaze asurin. shinneta leyom shiva asar — huttar shishsha asar, veneesar chamishsha asar veshiva asar.
Shinneta leyom shemona asar — hutteru kullan, veen asur ella mishshemona asar veelach. kashya lerav! amar lecha rav: lemuda shane.
Udekaare la, may kaare la? lemuda itztericha leh, mahu detema: kevan dilmuda vaakarteh — bitre zimne akra leh, ka mashma lan.
Metivi: raata yom esrim veechad bechodesh ze, yom esrim ushenayim bechodesh ze, yom esrim ushelosha bechodesh ze — kava lah veset. serga leyom esrim vearbaa — lo kava lah veset. teyuveta dishmuel!
Amar lach shemuel: hacha vemay askinan? kegon dirgila lemichze beyom esrim, veshinneta leyom esrim veechad. dayka name, deshavkeh leyom esrim venakteh leyom esrim veechad — shema minna.
Sheen haishsha kovaat lah veset ad shettikbaenna vechulei. amar rav pappa: la amaran ella lemikbea, aval lemechash la bachada zimna chayysha.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: hayta lemuda lihyot roa yom chamishsha asar, veshinneta leyom esrim — ze veze asurin!
I mehatam, hava amena: hane mille — hecha dekayyma betoch yeme niddatah, aval hecha dela kayyma betoch yeme niddatah — ema la. ka mashma lan.
Veenah mittaheret min havveset vechulei. amar rav pappa: la amaran ella dikvateh telata zimne, ditzrichi telata zimne lemikereh, aval tere zimne — bachada zimna miakar.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: en haishsha kovaat lah veset ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim! mahu detema: chada — lechad, tere — letarte, utelata — litlata, ka mashma lan.

Tanya kevateh derav pappa: hayta lemuda lihyot roa yom esrim, veshinneta layyom sheloshim — ze vaze asurin. higgia yom esrim velo raata — mutteret leshammesh ad yom sheloshim, vechosheshet leyom sheloshim.
Higgia yom sheloshim veraata, higgia yom esrim velo raata, vehiggia yom sheloshim velo raata, vehiggia yom esrim veraata — huttar yom sheloshim,
b: Veneesar yom esrim, mippene sheorach bizmanno ba.

Mishna nashim bivtulehem kigfanim, yesh gefen sheyyenah adom, veyesh gefen sheyyenah shachor, veyesh gefen sheyyenah merubbe, veyesh gefen sheyyenah muat. rabbi yehuda omer: kol gefen yesh bah yayin, vesheen bah yayin — hare ze dorketi.
Gemara tana: dor katua. tane rabbi chiyyay: keshem shehasseor yafe laissa, kach damim yafin laishsha. tana mishshum rabbi meir: kol ishsha sheddameha merubbin — baneha merubbin.
Hadaran alach haishsha.
Mishna tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot venisset — bet shammay omrim: notnin lah arba lelot, uvet hillel omrim: ad shettichye hammakka.
Higgia zemannah lirot venisset, bet shammay omrim: notnin lah layla harishon, uvet hillel omrim: ad motzae shabbat (arba) [arbaa] lelot.
Raata veodah bevet aviha, bet shammay omrim: notnin lah beilat mitzva, uvet hillel omrim: kol hallayla (kullah) [shellah].
Gemara amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vaafillu raata. mimmay? middeka mefalleg besefa ben raata ben beshello raata, mikkelal deresha — la shena hachi vela shena hachi.
Tanya name hachi: bet hillel omrim: ad shettichye hammakka, ben raata ben lo raata.

Ad shettichye hammakka. ad kamma? amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol zeman shennocheret. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: nechira zo eni yodea ma hi, ella kol zeman sheharok matzuy betoch happe mechamat tashmish.

Nechira dekaamar rav, hechi dame? amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derav — omedet veroa, yoshevet veenah roa — beyadua shello chayta hammakka. al gabbe karka veroa, al gabbe karim uchesatot veenah roa — beyadua shello chayta hammakka. al gabbe kullam veroa, al gabbe kullam veenah roa — beyadua shechayta hammakka.
Higgia zemannah vechulei. ittemar: shimmesha bayyamim — rav amar: lo hifsida lelot, velevi amar: hifsida lelot.
Rav amar: lo hifsida lelot, ad "motzae shabbat" tenan. velevi amar: hifsida lelot. may "arba lelot" dekatane? arbaa onot.

Ulerav, lema li lemitne "arbaa lelot"? orach ara ka mashma lan, dedarkah devia ballelot. ulelevi, litne "arbaa lelot", "ad motzae shabbat" lema li? ha ka mashma lan dishre lemival lechattechilla beshabbat.
Kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: pirtza dechuka muttar likkanes bah beshabbat, veaf al pi shemmashshir tzerorot.
Ittemar: baal velo matza dam, vechazar uvaal umatza dam, rabbi chanina amar: temea, verabbi assi amar: tehora.

Rabbi chanina amar: temea, deim ita dahava dam betulim — meikkara hava ate. verabbi assi amar: tehora, dilma itremi leh kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: "yacholni livol kamma beilot belo dam". veiddach — shane shemuel derav guvereh.
Amar rav: bogeret notnin lah layla harishon, vehane mille shello raata, aval raata — en lah ella beilat mitzva vetu la.
Metivi: maase venatan lah rabbi (arba) [arbaa] lelot mittoch shenem asar chodesh. hechi dame? illema deyahev la kullehu bime katnut,

a: "Ad shettichye hammakka" tenan!

Ella deyahev la kullehu bime naarut — naarut shenem asar chodesh mi ikka? veha amar shemuel: en ben naarut levagrut ella shishsha chodashim bilvad! vechi tema betzir mehachi hu delekka, ha tefe ikka — ha "bilvad" kaamar.
Ella, deyahev la shetayim bime katnut ushetayim bime naarut, ha bea minneh rav chinnana bar shelemya merav: higgia zemannah lirot tachat balah, mahu?
Amar leh: kol beilot sheatta boel — enan ella achat, vehashshear mashlimin learbaa lelot.

Ella, deyahev la achat bime katnut, ushetayim bime naarut, veachat bime bagrut. i amrat bishlama bogeret bealma yahavinan la tefe, ki hechi deahanay katnut bime naarut lemivtzar la chada, ahanay name naarut levagrut lemivtzar la chada.
Ella i amrat bogeret dealma la yahavinan la tefe — la littev la ella beilat mitzva, vetu la!
Leolam, deyahev la achat bime katnut veshalosh bime naarut. mi savrat kol telata yarche — chada ona? kol tere yarche — chada ona.
Minyamin saksenaa hava shakel veazel leatreh dishmuel, sevar lemebad ovada kevavteh derav, afillu raata. amar: la paleg rav ben raata ben lo raata.
Kedem shechev beorcha, kare shemuel aleh derav "lo yeunne latztzaddik kol aven".

Amar rav chinnana bar shelemya mishshemeh derav: kevan shennitteku shinnav shel adam, nitmaatu mezonotav, shenneemar: "gam anochi natatti lach nikyon shinnayim bechol arechem vechoser lechem bechol mekomotechem".
Raata veodah. tanu rabbanan: raata veodah bevet aviha, bet hillel omrim: kol hallayla shellah, venotnin lah ona shelema. vechamma ona shelema? peresh rabban shimon ben gamliel: layla vachatzi yom.
Umi baenan kulle hay? ureminhi: hare shehayu gittav uvet baddav temeot, uvikkesh laasotan betohora, ketzad hu ose? haddappin vehallulavin vehaadashin — medichan,
b: Haakalim shel netzarim veshel bitzbutz — menaggevan, shel shifa veshel gemi — meyayshshenan. vechamma meyayshshenan? shenem asar chodesh. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mannichan miggat laggat umibbad levad.
Hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu charfe veafle.

Rabbi yose omer: harotze letaher miyyad, magilan berotchin o choltan beme zetim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yose: mannichan tachat hatztzinnor shemmemav mekallechin, o bemayayn shemmemav rodfin. vechamma ona? kederech sheamru beyen nesech, kach amru bitharot.
Kelappe leyay! bitharot kayyminan! ella, kederech sheamru bitharot, kach amru beyen nesech.

Vechamma ona? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: o yom o layla. rabbi chana sheuna, veamri la rabbi chana bar sheuna, amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan: chatzi yom vachatzi layla.
Veamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: vela peligi — ha bitkufat nisan vetishri, ha bitkufat tammuz vetevet.
Hacha name, ema gabbe nidda chatzi yom vachatzi layla! veha "layla vachatzi yom" kaamar! ella: i layla denisan vetishri, i chatzi yom vachatzi layla detevet vetammuz.
Veibbaet ema: shane ketubba — demaggehi ba tefe, ad dechatmi.
Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: halacha — boel beilat mitzva, uforesh.
Metiv rav chisda: maase venatan lah rabbi arbaa lelot mittoch shenem asar chodesh!
Amar leh rava: haddore appircha lema li? otev mimmatnitin! hu savar: maase rav.
Mikkol makom, lerav ushemuel kashya! inhu daavadu kerabbotenu, detanya: rabbotenu chazru venimnu — boel beilat mitzva uforesh.
Amar ulla: ki havu ba rabbi yochanan veresh lakish betinoket, la havo masseki minna ella kidmassek taala mibbe cherava, umesayyeymi ba hachi: boel beilat mitzva uforesh.
Amar lo rabbi abba lerav ashe: ella meatta, baal nefesh lo yigmor biato! amar lo: im ken, libbo nokfo uforesh.
Tanu rabbanan: vechullan shehayu shofot dam uvaot, mittoch arbaa lelot leachar arbaa lelot, mittoch hallayla leachar hallayla — kullan tzerichot livdok et atzman.
Uvechullan, rabbi meir machmir kedivre bet shammay.
Ushear reiyyot shebben bet shammay uvet hillel — hallech achar mare damim.

Shehaya rabbi meir omer: mare damim meshunnim hen ze mizze. ketzad? dam nidda — adom, dam betulim — eno adom. dam nidda — zihum, dam betulim — eno zihum. dam nidda — ba min hammakor, dam betulim — ba min hatztzedadin.
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar rabbi yose, amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim kol mare damim achat hen.
Tanu rabbanan: haroa dam mechamat tashmish — meshammeshet paam rishona, usheniyya, ushelishit, mikkan veelach — lo teshammesh ad shettitgaresh

a: Vetinnase leacher.

Nisset leacher, veraata dam mechamat tashmish — meshammeshet paam rishona usheniyya ushelishit, mikkan veelach lo teshammesh ad shettitgaresh vetinnase leacher. nisset leacher, veraata dam mechamat tashmish — meshammeshet paam rishona usheniyya ushelishit, mikkan veelach lo teshammesh ad shettivdok atzmah.

Ketzad bodeket et atzmah? mevia shefoferet, uvetochah michchol, umoch munnach al rosho. im nimtza dam al rosh hammoch — beyadua shemmin hammakor hu ba. lo nimtza dam al rosho — beyadua shemmin hatztzedadin hu ba.
Veim yesh lah makka beoto makom — tola bemakkatah, veim yesh lah veset — tola bevistah.
Veim haya dam makkatah meshunne middam reiyyaytah — enah tola, veneemenet ishsha lomar "makka yesh li bammakor shemmimmenna dam yotze", divre rabbi.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: dam makka habba min hammakor — tame, verabbotenu heidu al dam hammakka habba min hammakor shehu tahor.
May benayyhu? amar ulla: makor mekomo tame ikka benayyhu.
Shefoferet — (afgore mafgera) [afsode mafseda] la! amar shemuel: bishfoferet shel avar, ufiha ratzuf letochah.
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: vetivdok atzmah bevia shelishit shel baal harishon? amar leh: lefi sheen kol haetzbaot shavot.
Amar leh: vetivdok atzmah bevia rishona shel baal shelishi? lefi sheen kol hakkochot shavot.
Hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi, amar leh leabbadan: zil baata. azal baata, venafal mimmenna chararat dam. amar rabbi: nitrappea zot.

Hahi itteta daatay lekammeh demar shemuel, amar leh lerav dimi bar yosef: zil baata! azal baata, vela nefal (mimmenna) [minna] vela midde. amar shemuel: zo memallea venofetzet hi, vechol hamemallea venofetzet — en lah takkana.
Hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi yochanan, dechol emat dahavat salka mittevilat mitzva, havat kachazya dema. amar la: shemma dimat irich alta bich, lechi vehibbaali lo al gabbe hannahar.

Ikka deamar, amar la: tegalli lechavrotich. ki hechi (datehavev) [detavvhan] alaych lehach gisa, nitvevhu alach lehach gisa. veikka deamar, amar lah: galli lechavrotich, ki hechi delivo alaych rachamim, detanya: "vetame tame yikra" — tzarich lehodia tzaaro larabbim, verabbim mevakkeshim alav rachamim.
Amar rav yosef: hava ovada befumebdita, veittassi.
Amar rav yosef, amar rav yehuda, amar rav: hitkin rabbi besadot, raata yom echad — teshev shishsha vehu,
Shenayim — teshev shishsha, vehen shelosha — teshev shiva nekiyyim.
Amar rabbi zera: benot yisrael hechemiru al atzman, sheafillu root tippat dam kechardal — yoshvot aleha shiva nekiyyim.
Adbereh rava lerav shemuel, vedaresh: kishsheta shene yamim, velashshelishi hippila — teshev shiva nekiyyim. kasavar: en kashave linfalim, vei efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava: may irya kishsheta shene yamim? afillu mashshehu bealma! deha amar rabbi zera: benot yisrael hechemiru al atzman, sheafillu root tippat dam kechardal — yoshvot aleha shiva nekiyyim!
Amar leh Rava: amena lach issura, veat amrat minhaga?! hecha deachmur — achmur, hecha dela achmur — la achmur.
(Tevauha, neter, bechammin, litvul, kematim, al gabbe, namal — siman). amar rava: tevauha linnase venitpayyeysa — tzericha shetteshev shiva nekiyyim.
Ravina esok leh livreh be rav chanina, amar leh: savar leh mar lemichtav ketuva learbaa yom? amar leh: in. ki meta learbaa, netar ad arbea acharina, iakkav shiva yome batar hahu yoma.

Amar leh: may hay? amar leh: la savar la mar leha derava, deamar rava: tevauha linnase venitpayyeysa tzericha leshev shiva nekiyyim? amar leh: emar deamar rava bigdola dekachazya dema, aval biktanna dela chazya dema — mi amar?
Amar leh: beferush amar rava: la shena gedola, la shena ketanna. gedola tama may? mishshum demechamada, ketanna name mechamada.
Amar rava: ishsha
b: La tichof lo beneter velo bachol; beneter mishshum demikketaf, uvachol mishshum dimsarech.
Veamar ammemar mishshemeh derava: ishsha lo tichof ella bechammin, aval lo betzonen, vaafillu bechamme chamma. tzonen may tama la? mishshum dekarire umesharu mazzeyay.
Veamar rava: leolam yilmad adam betoch beto shettehe ishsha medicha bet kamteh bemayim. metivi: bet hakkematim uvet hassetarim enan tzerichin leviat mayim!
Nehi deviat mayim la baenan, mekom harauy leviat mayim baenan, kidrabbi zera, deamar rabbi zera: kol harauy levilla — en billa meakkevet bo, vesheen rauy levilla — billa meakkevet bo.
Amar ravin bar rav adda, amar rabbi yitzchak: maase beshifchato shel rabbi shettavla, vealta, venimtza lah etzem chotzetz ben shinneha, vehitzrichah rabbi tevila acheret.
Veamar rava: tavla vealta, venimtza aleha davar chotzetz — im samuch lachafifa tavla, enah tzericha lechof velitbol, veim lav — tzericha lechof velitbol.
Ikka deamri, im beoto yom shechaffa tavla — enah tzericha lechof velitbol, veim lav — tzericha lechof velitbol.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu lemismach lachafifa tevila, lemichaf bimama ulemitbal belelya.
Amar rava: ishsha lo taamod al gabbe keli cheres vetitbol. savar rav kahana lememar: tama may? mishshum gezerat merchatzaot, ha al gabbe silta — shappir dame.
Amar leh rav chanan minnehardea: hatam tama may — mishshum devaet, silta name beeta.
Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: ishsha lo titbol

a: Benamel, af al gav dehashta lekka — emar beridyone nefal.
Avu dishmuel avad livnateh mikvavot beyome nisan, umappatze beyome tishre.
Amar rav giddel, amar rav: natna tavshil livnah, vetavla vealta — lo alta lah tevila, af al gav dehashta lekka, emar beridyone nefal.
Amar rame bar abba: hane rivde dechusilta, ad telata yome — la chayytzi, mikkan veelach — chayytzi.
Amar mar ukeva: lifluf shebbaayin, lach — eno chotzetz, yavesh — chotzetz. ematay nikra yavesh? mishshaa shemmatchil lirak.
Amar shemuel: kechol shebbetoch haayin — eno chotzetz, vesheal gabbe haayin — chotzetz. im hayu eneha porchot — afillu al gabbe haayin eno chotzetz.
Amar rabbi yochanan: patcha eneha beyoter, o atzmah eneha beyoter — lo alta lah tevila.
Amar resh lakish: haishsha lo titbol ella derech gedilatah, keditnan: haish nira keoder umosek zetim, ishsha niret keoreget vechimnika et benah.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: nima achat keshura chotzetzet,
b: Shalosh enan chotztzot, shetayim eni yodea. verabbi yochanan amar: anu en lanu ella achat.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: devar tora, rubbo hammakpid alav — chotzetz, rubbo veeno makpid alav — eno chotzetz, vegazru al rubbo sheeno makpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid, vegazru al miuto hammakpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid.
Veligzor name al miuto sheeno makpid, mishshum miuto hammakpid! hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?!

Amar rav: nidda bizmannah enah tovelet ella ballayla, veshello bizmannah tovelet ben bayyom ben ballayla. rabbi yochanan amar: ben bizmannah ben shello bizmannah enah tovelet ella ballayla, mishshum serech bittah.
Veaf rav hadar beh, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: nidda, ben bizmannah ben shello bizmannah, enah tovelet ella ballayla, mishshum serech bittah.
Atken rav idi benaresh lemitbal beyoma ditmanya, mishshum aryavata; rav acha bar yaakov befapponya, mishshum gannave;
Rav yehuda befumebdita, mishshum tzinna; rava bemachoza, mishshum avullae.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava uleabbaye: mikkede haiddana kullehu safek zavot shavvinhu rabbanan, laytbelinhu bimama deshivya?
Mishshum derabbi shimon, detanya: "achar tithar" — achar, achar lechullan, shello tehe tumea mafseket benehen. rabbi shimon omer: "achar tithar" — achar maase tithar.
Aval amru chachamim: asur laasot ken, shemma tavo lide safek.
Amar rav huna: ishsha chofefet beechad bashshabbat, vetovelet bishlishi bashshabbat, shekken ishsha chofefet beerev shabbat, vetovelet bemotzae shabbat.
Ishsha chofefet beechad bashshabbat, vetovelet birvii bashshabbat — shekken ishsha chofefet beerev shabbat, vetovelet bemotzae yom tov shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat.

Ishsha chofefet beechad bashshabbat, vetovelet bachamishi bashshabbat — shekken ishsha chofefet beerev shabbat, vetovelet bemotzae shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat.
Verav chisda amar: kullehu amrinan, "shekken" la amrinan. hecha deefshar — efshar, hecha dela efshar — la efshar.

Verav yemar amar: afillu "shekken" name amrinan, levar meishsha chofefet beechad bashshabbat vetovelet bachamishi bashshabbat, dilmotzae shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana shelleachar hashshabbat leta, deefshar dechofefet ballayla vetovelet ballayla.
Derash marimar: hilcheta kerav chisda, uchedimtaretz rav yemar.
Ibbaya lehu: ishsha mahu shettachof ballayla vetitbol ballayla? mar zutera osar, verav chinnana missura share.
Amar leh rav adda lerav chinnana missura: lav hachi hava ovada bidvethu deabba mari resh galuta, deikkut, azal rav nachman bar yitzchak lefayyosa, vaamara leh: may iteh hasheta?

a: Tisge ayyti limchar, vida may kaamra leh, amar: dude chasrat, tashtake chasrat, avde chasrat?
Derash rava: ishsha chofefet beerev shabbat vetovelet bemotzae shabbat. amar leh rav pappa lerava: veha shelach ravin beiggarteh "ishsha lo tachof beerev shabbat vetitbol bemotzae shabbat".
Utema al atzmecha: heach chofefet bayyom vetovelet ballayla, ha baenan techef lachafifa tevila, velekka!

Hadar oki rava amora aleh, uderash: devarim sheamarti lifnechem, taut hen beyadi. beram kach amru mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: ishsha lo tachof beerev shabbat vetitbol bemotzae shabbat, utema al atzmecha: heach chofefet bayyom vetovelet ballayla? ha baenan samuch lachafifa tevila, velekka!
Vehilcheta: ishsha chofefet bayyom vetovelet ballayla. vehilcheta: ishsha lo tachof ella ballayla. (ella) kashya hilcheta ahilcheta!
La kashya — ha deefshar, ha dela efshar.
Mishna nidda shebbadka atzmah yom shevii shacharit, umatza tehora, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar yamim badka umatza temea — hare hi bechezkat tehora.
Badka atzmah beyom shevii shacharit umatza temea, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar zeman badka umatza tehora — hare zo bechezkat temea.
Umetammea meet leet, umippekida lifkida. veim yesh lah veset — dayya sheatah.

Verabbi yehuda omer: kol shello hifrisha betohora min hammincha ulemala — hare zo bechezkat temea, vachachamim omrim: afillu bishnayim leniddatah badka umatza tehora, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar zeman badka umatza temea — hare zo bechezkat tehora.
Gemara ittemar: rav amar: zava vadday, velevi amar: zava safek.
Aheyay? illema aresha — "hare zo bechezkat tehora" katane!
Ella assefa, bishlama sefek zava amrinan, ella zava vadday name? hare badka umatza tehora!

Ella, ki ittemar derav velevi — shemata beappe nafsha ittemar: nidda shebbadka atzmah beyom hashshevii shacharit umatza temea, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar yamim badka umatza temea — rav amar: zava vadday, velevi amar: zava safek.
Rav amar: zava vadday, kevan demeikkara nimtzet temea, veachshav nimtzet temea — temea vadday. velevi amar: sefek zava, emar pesaka bene uvene.
b: Vechen tane levi bematnita: achar hayyamim, ben badka umatza tehora ben badka umatza temea — hare zo sefek zava.
Umetammea meet leet. lema tihve teyuveta derava! deamar rava: lomar sheen haishsha metammea meet leet betoch yeme zivatah!
Velav otvinneh lerava chada zimna! hachi kaamrinan: lema tihve teyuveta derava name meha!
Amar lach rava: ki katane "metammea meet leet" — aresh pirkin kae, araata veodah bevet aviha.
Salka datach amena, kevan demafseki lehu yamim tehorin, kitchillat niddatah damya, velo tetamme meet leet, ka mashma lan.
Im yesh lah veset. nema tihve teyuveta derav huna bar chiyyay amar shemuel, deamar rav huna bar chiyyay amar shemuel, lomar sheen haishsha kovaat lah veset bime zivatah.
Amar lecha rav huna bar chiyyay: ki amrinan en ishsha kovaat lah veset bime zivatah, dela baaya telata zimne lemikar, deamrinan dameha mesullakin, vechevan dedameha mesullakin — dayyah sheatah.
Rabbi yehuda omer. tanya, amru lo lerabbi yehuda: ilmale yadeha munnachot beeneha kol ben hashshemashot — yafe atta omer.
Achshav emar: im silluk yadeha raata? ma li hifrisha betohora bashshevii min hammincha ulemala, ma li hifrisha betohora barishon.
Barishon — mi ikka leman deamar?

In, vehatanya: amar rabbi: shaalti et rabbi yose verabbi shimon keshehayu mehallechim badderech: nidda shebbadka atzmah yom shevii shacharit umatza tehora, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar hayyamim badka umatza temea — mahu?
Amru liv: hare zo bechezkat tohora. shishshi, chamishi, revii, shelishi, sheni — may? amru liv: la shena.
Barishon lo shaalti, vetaiti shello shaalti, attu kullehu lav bechezkat tumea kayymi? vechevan difsak — pesak, rishon name kevan difsak — pesak.
Umeikkara, may savar? hoil vehuchezak mayan patuach.

Mishna hazzav vehazzava, shebbadku atzman beyom rishon umatzu tahor, uvayyom hashshevii umatzu tahor, ushear yamim shebbentayim lo badku — rabbi eliezer omer: hare hen bechezkat tohora. rabbi yehoshua omer: en lahem ella yom rishon veyom shevii bilvad. rabbi akiva omer: en lahem ella yom shevii bilvad.
Gemara tanya: amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua: lidvarecha, atta mone beserugin, vehattora amra "achar tithar", achar achar lechullan, shello tehe tumea mafseket benehen!
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: veatta i atta mode bezav sheraa keri, uvenazir shehillech sechachot uferaot, shemmone beserugin? vehattora amra: "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu".
Verabbi eliezer, bishlama hatam, "letoma vah" amar rachamana — sheenah soteret ella yomah, vei mishshum ichallofe zav bevaal keri — la michallaf.
Nazir shehillech al gabbe sechachot uferaot name, middeorayyta ohel mealleya baenan, verabbanan hu digzur, verabbanan bidorayyta la michallaf.
Aval hacha — i chayyshinan dilma chazay, besafek ate leichallofe bevadday.
Tane rabbi yose verabbi shimon amri: nirin divre rabbi eliezer middivre rabbi yehoshua, vedivre rabbi akiva middivre kullan, aval halacha kerabbi eliezer.
Ibbaya lehu: hazzav vehazzava shebbadku atzman yom rishon veyom shemini umatzu tahor, ushear hayyamim lo badku,

a: Lerabbi eliezer mahu? techillatan vesofan baenan, vehacha techillatan ikka sofan lekka, o dilma techillatan af al gav sheen sofan?
Amar rav: hi hi techillatan, af al pi sheen sofan, verabbi chanina amar: techillatan vesofan baenan, hacha techillatan ikka, sofan lekka.
Metivi: veshavin bezav uvezava shebbadku atzman yom rishon veyom shemini umatzu tahor, sheen lahem ella shemini bilvad. man shavin? lav rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua?
La, rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva.
Amar rav sheshet, amar rav yirmeya bar abba, amar rav: nidda shehifrisha betohora bashshelishi shellah — sofarto leminyan shiva nekiyyim.
Nidda, sefira lema la? ella ema: zava shehifrisha betohora bashshelishi shellah — sofarto leminyan shiva nekiyyim.
Amar leh rav sheshet lerav yirmeya bar abba: rav kechutae amra lishmateh? deamri: yom shepposeket bo sofarto leminyan shiva!
Ki kaamar rav, levar mishshelishi. bar mishshelishi? peshita! la tzericha, kegon delo badka ad shevii.
Veashmeinan hatam — techillatan, af al pi sheen sofan, vehacha ka mashma lan — sofan, af al pi sheen techillatan.
Demahu detema: techillatan af al pi sheen sofan hu deamrinan, deokminhu achezkayyhu, aval sofan af al pi sheen techillatan — la, ka mashma lan.
Ini? veha ki ata ravin amar: metiv rabbi yose berabbi chanina "toa".
Vela yadana may teyuveteh, dekayyma lan: shavua kamma deatya lekamman — belelavata matbelinan la, bimama la matbelinan la.
Vei salka datach la baenan sefurin lefanenu, bimama name natbelina, dilma yoledet zachar bezov hi, veavda la sefurin! ella lav shema minna baenan sefurin befanenu!
Velav mi okemna kerabbi akiva, deamar: baenan sefurin lefanenu?!
Umena temra dilrabbanan la baenan sefurin lefanenu? ditnan: toa sheamra "yom echad tame raiti", matbilin otah tesha tevilot.
Sheva lenidda, utere leziva. "ben hashshemashot tame raiti" — matbilin otah achat esre tevilot.
Achat esre may avidtayyhu? amar rav yirmeya middifti: kegon shebbat lefanenu ben hashshemashot,
Vehavyayn tamne lenidda utelat leziva.
"Lo raiti kol ikkar" — matbilin otah chamesh esre tevilot. amar rava: hay dina dela dina, dayyni begallache, deit leh tora — lire chad yoma, delet leh tora — lire tere yome.

Itremi lehu yatma bar armalta, yahavi leh tore, azal nachsinhu. amar lehu: deit leh tora — lishkol chad mashka, delet leh tora — lishkol tere mashche. amri leh: may hay dekaamrat? amar lehu: sof dina kitchillat dina, techillat dina — lav man delet leh adif? sof dina name — man delet leh adif.
Hacha name, uma hecha deamra "raiti" — saggi lah i betesha tevilot i beachat esre tevilot, hecha dekaamra ihi "la raiti" — baaya chamesh esre tevilot?
Ella ema hachi: "raiti veeni yodea kamma raiti, i bime nidda raiti o bime ziva raiti" — matbilin otah chamesh esre tevilot. atay kamman bimama — yahavinan la shav lenidda
b: Vetamne leziva, atay kamman belelavata — yahavinan la tamne lenidda veshav leziva.
Ziva, tamne baaya! ella: idde veidde — shav lenidda, vetamne leziva.
Belelavata, tamne lenidda bae!

Ziva difsika leh, dela shena ki atya kamman bimama, la shena ki atya kamman belelya — chashiv la. nidda dela pesika leh, dechi atya kamman belelavata — bae tamne, bimama — la kavae tamne, la kachashev la.
Vei salka datach sefurin lefanenu baenan — kol hane tevilot lema li? tispor shav vahadar titbol! ella lav shema minna rabbanan hi, deamri: la baenan sefurin lefanenu.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe: lav tarotze kamtartzinan la? taretz veema hachi: "safarti veeni yodaat kamma safarti, im bime nidda safarti veim bime ziva safarti" — matbilin otah chamesh esre tevilot.
"Safarti veeni yodaat kamma safarti" — chad yoma miha i efshar dela safra, chasra lah tevila!
Ella ema: "eni yodaat im safarti im lo safarti".
Mishna hazzav, vehazzava, vehannidda, vehayyoledet, vehammetzora shemmetu — metammein bemassa, ad sheyyimmok habbasar. nochri shemmet — tahor milletamme.
Bet shammay omrim: kol hannashim metot niddot, uvet hillel omrim: en nidda ella shemmeta nidda.
Gemara may bemassa? illema bemassa mammash — attu kol met mi la metamme bemassa!
Ella may bemassa? beeven mesama,
Dichtiv: "vehetayit even chada vesumat al pum gubba".
May tama? amar rav: gezera, shemma yitallefe.
Tana mishshum rabbi eliezer amru: ad sheyyibbaka kereso.
Nochri shemmet [kulei]. tanya, amar rabbi: mippene ma amru nochri shemmet tahor milletamme bemassa? lefi sheen tumeato mechayyim middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim.
Tanu rabbanan: shenem asar devarim shaalu anshe alekkesanderiyya et rabbi yehoshua ben chinnana, shelosha divre chachma, shelosha divre haggada, shelosha divre vurut, shelosha divre derech eretz.
Shelosha divre chachma: hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet vehammetzora shemmetu, ad matay metammein bemassa? amar lahen: ad sheyyimmok habbasar.
Bat meshullachat, ma hi lechohen?

Mi amrinan kal vachomer, uma almana lechohen gadol sheen issurah shave bakkol — benah pagum, zo sheissurah shave bakkol — eno din shebbenah pagum? o dilma: ma lealmana lechohen gadol — shehi atzmah mitchallelet.
Amar lahen:

a: Hi toeva veen baneha toavin.
Shene metzorain shennitarvu korbenotehen ze baze, vekarav korbano shel echad mehen, umet echad mehen — hashsheni ma tehe alav?
Amar lahen: kotev nechasav laacherim, vehave ani, umevi chattat haof habba al hassafek.
Vehaikka asham! amar shemuel: keshekkarav ashamo.
Amar rav sheshet: gavra rabba kishmuel lema ki hay milleta? keman? i kerabbi yehuda, deamar: "asham kava", vechevan dekavao le asham baashirut — la matze mayyte chattat bedallut.
Ditnan: metzora shehevi korban ani veheeshir, o ashir veheeni — hakkol holech achar chattat, divre rabbi shimon.
Verabbi yehuda omer: hakkol holech achar asham. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: hakkol holech achar tzippovrim.
Vei kerabbi shimon, deamar: chattat kava, af al gav dela kerav asham — nayte acher, deha shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar: layyte velitne.
Detanya, amar rabbi shimon: lammochorat mevi ashamo veluggo immo, umaamido beshaar nikanor, umatne alav veomer: im metzora hu — hare ashamo veluggo immo, veim lav — asham ze yehe shalme nedava.
Veoto asham taun
b: Shechitato batztzafon, vetaun mattenat behonot, usemicha, unesachim, utenufa, vechaze vashok, veneechol lezichre chehunna leyom valayla.
Velo hodu lo chachamim lerabbi shimon, mippene shemmevi kadashim levet happesul!
Shemuel savar la kerabbi shimon bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Shelosha divre aggada: katuv echad omer "ki lo echpotz bemot hammet", vechatuv echad omer "ki chafetz Adonai lahamitam"! kan beosin teshuva, kan besheen osin teshuva.
Katuv echad omer: "ki lo yissa fanim velo yikkach shochad", vechatuv echad omer: "yissa Adonai panav elecha"! kan kodem gezar din, kan leachar gezar din.

Katuv echad omer "ki vachar Adonai betziyyon", vechatuv echad omer "ki al appi veal chamati hayta hair hazzot lemin hayyom asher banu otah ad hayyom hazze"! kan kodem shennasa shelomo et bat paro, kan leachar shennasa shelomo et bat paro.
Shelosha divre burut: ishto shel lot, mahu shettetamme? amar lahem: met metamme, veen netziv melach metamme.
Ben shunammit, mahu sheyyetamme? amar lahen: met metamme, veen chay metamme.
Metim leatid lavo, tzerichin hazzaa shelishi ushevii o en tzerichin? amar lahen: lichsheyyichyu nechkam lahen. ikka deamri: lichsheyyavo moshe rabbenu immahem.

Shelosha divre derech eretz, ma yaase adam veyechkam? amar lahen: yarbe bishiva, vimaet bischora. amru: harebe asu ken, velo hoil lahem! ella yevakkeshu rachamim mimmi shehachochma shello, shenneemar: "ki Adonai yitten chochma mippiv daat utevuna".
Tane rabbi chiyyay: mashal lemelech basar vadam sheasa seuda laavadav, umeshagger leohavav mimma shellefanav.
May ka mashma lan? deha bela ha la saggi.

Ma yaase adam veyitashsher? amar lahen: yarbe bischora, veyissa veyitten beemuna. amru lo: harebe asu ken, velo hoilu! ella yevakkesh rachamim mimmi shehaosher shello, shenneemar: "li hakkesef veli hazzahav".
May ka mashma lan, deha bela ha la saggi.
Ma yaase adam veyihyu lo banim zecharim? amar lahem: yissa ishsha hahogenet lo,

a: Vaykaddesh atzmo bishat tashmish.
Amru: harebe asu ken, velo hoilu! ella yevakkesh rachamim mimmi shehabbanim shello, shenneemar: "hinne nachalat Adonai banim sachar peri habbaten".
May ka mashma lan? deha bela ha la saggi.

May "sachar peri habbaten"? amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: bischar shemmeshahin atzman babbeten, kede (shettazria ishto) [sheyyazriu neshotehen] techilla — noten lo hakkadosh baruch hu sechar peri habbeten.

Bet shammay omrim [vechulei]. may tamayyhu devet shammay? i nema mishshum dichtiv "vattitchalchal hammalka", veamar rav: melammed sheppersa nidda. hacha name, aggav biatuta demalacha demota — chazya, vehaanan tenan shecharada mesalleket et haddamim! ha la kashya: pachda — tzamet, biatuta — merappeya.
Ella, ha ditnan: bet shammay omrim: kol haanashim metim zavin, uvet hillel omrim: en zav ella mi shemmet zav.
Ikkeri kan "mibbesaro", velo mechamat onso!

Ella tama devet shammay, kidtanya: barishona hayu matbilin kelim al gabbe niddot metot, vehayu niddot chayyot mitbayyeyshot — hitkinu sheyyehu matbilin al gabbe kol hannashim, mippene kevodan shel niddot chayyot.
Barishona hayu matbilin al gabbe zavin metin, vehayu zavin chayyin mitbayyeyshin — hitkinu sheyyehu matbilin al gabbe kol haanashim, mippene kevodan shel zavin chayyim.
Mishna haishsha shemmeta, veyatza mimmenna reviit dam — metammea mishshum ketem, umetammea beohel.

Rabbi yehuda omer: enah metammea mishshum ketem, mippene shenneekar mishshemmeta. umode rabbi yehuda beyoshevet al mashber vameta, veyatza mimmenna reviit dam shehi metammea mishshum ketem. amar rabbi yose: lefichach enah metammea beohel.
Gemara mikkelal detanna kamma savar, af al gav deneekar dam mishshemmeta, metammea mishshum ketem?
Amar rabbi zeeri: makor mekomo tame ikka benayyhu.
Umode rabbi yehuda.
Mikkelal detanna kamma savar beohel name metamme? amar rav yehuda: dam tevusa ikka benayyhu.

Detanya: ezehu dam tevusa? peresh rabbi elazar berabbi yehuda: harug sheyyatza mimmennu dam ben bechayyav ben bemoto, safek bechayyav yatza, safek bemoto yatza, safek bechayyav uvemoto — zehu dam tevusa.
Vachachamim omrim: birshut hayyachid — sefeko tame, birshut harabbim — sefeko tahor.
Ella ezehu dam tevusa? harug sheyyatza hemennu reviit dam bechayyav uvemoto, vaadayin lo pasak, safek rubbo bechayyav umiuto bemoto, sefek miuto bechayyav verubbo bemoto — zehu dam tevusa.
Rabbi yehuda omer: harug sheyyatza mimmennu reviit dam, vehaya muttal bammitta vedamo metaftef legumma — tame, mippene shehattippa shel mita meorevet bo. vachachamim metaharin, mippene
b: Sherishon rishon nifsak. shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi yehuda! rabbi yehuda letameh deamar: en dam mevattel dam.
Rabbi shimon omer: tzaluv al haetz, sheddamo shotet laaretz, venimtza tachtav reviit dam — tame. rabbi yehuda metaher, sheani omer: tippa shel mita omedet lo al gav haetz.
Verabbi yehuda, nema ihu lenafsheh: sheani omer "tippa shel mita omedet al gav hammitta"! shane mitta, dimchalchala.
Mishna barishona hayu omrim: hayyoshevet al dam tohar hayta meara mayim lefesach.
Chazru lomar: hare hi kemagga teme met lekadashim, kedivre bet hillel. bet shammay omrim: af kitme met.
Gemara meara — in, nogaat — la. alma: chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh — kekodesh damu.
Ema sefa: chazru lomar hare hi kemagga teme met lekadashim — lekadashim in, lechullin la, alma: chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh lav kekodesh damu!
Matnitin manni? abba shaul hi, detanya: abba shaul omer: tevul yom techilla lakkodesh, letamme shenayim velifsol echad.
Mishna umodim shehi ochelet bemaaser, vekotza lah challa, umakkefet vekora lah shem,
Veim nafal merukkah umiddam tohorah al kikkar shel teruma — shehu tahor.
Bet shammay omrim: tzericha tevila baacharona, uvet hillel omrim: enah tzericha tevila baacharona.
Gemara deamar mar: taval veala — ochel bemaaser.
Vekotza lah challa. chullin hattevulin lechalla — lav kechalla damu.
Umakkefet. deamar mar: mitzva litrom min hammukkaf.
Vekora lah shem. salka datach amena: nigzor, dilma ate leminnega ba meabbaray? ka mashma lan.
Veim nafal merukkah. ditnan: mashke tevul yom mashkin hayyotzin mimmennu (kemashkin) [kemashke] hannogea bahem, veellu veellu enan metammein, chutz mimmashke hazzav shehu av hattumea.
Bet shammay. may benayyhu? amar rav kattina: tevul yom aroch ikka benayyhu.
Mishna haroa yom achad asar, vetavla laerev, veshimmesha —
Bet shammay omer: metammein mishkav umoshav, vechayyayvin bekorban.

a: Uvet hillel omrim: peturim min hakkorban.
Tavla bayyom shelleacharav, veshimmesha et betah, veachar kach raata — bet shammay omrim: metammein mishkav umoshav, ufeturin min hakkorban.
Uvet hillel omrim: hare ze gargeran, umodim beroa betoch achad asar yom, vetavla laerev veshimmesha — shemmetammein mishkav umoshav, vechayyayvin bekorban.
Tavla bayyom shelleacharav, veshimmesha — hare ze tarbut raa, umaggaan uveilatan teluyin.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: veshavin bitvilat layla lezava — sheenah tevila, veshavin beroa betoch achad asar yom vetavla laerev veshimmesha — shemmetammea mishkav umoshav, vechayyayvin bekorban.
Lo nechleku ella beyom achad asar yom, shebbet shammay omrim: metammein mishkav umoshav vechayyayvin bekorban, uvet hillel potrin mikkorban.
Amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel: may shena yom achad asar miyyom toch achad asar? im shayva lo lattumea, lo yishve lo lakkorban?
Amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay: lo, im amarta betoch achad asar yom, shekken yom shelleacharav mitztaref immo leziva, tomru beyom achad asar, sheen yom shelleacharav mitztaref immo leziva?!
Amru lahem bet shammay: hashevu middotechem! im shayva lo lattumea — yishve lo lakkorban, veim lo shayva lo lakkorban — lo yishve lo lattumea.
Amru lahem bet hillel: im havenuhu lide tumea lehachamir, lo neviehu lide korban lehakel.

Veod middivrechem attem noshchin, sheattem omrin: tavla yom shelleacharav, veshimmesha, veachar kach raata — metamme mishkav umoshav, ufetura min hakkorban. af attem hashevu middotechem: im shayva lo lattumea, yishve lo lakkorban.
Veim lo shayva lo lekorban, lo yishve lo lattumea! ella lehachemir velo lehakel; hacha name — lehachemir velo lehakel.
Amar rav huna: mishkavah umoshavah shebbashsheni, bet shammay metammein, af al pi shettavla, af al pi shello raata. may tama? kevan deillu chazya metammea, hasheta name metammeya.
Amar rav yosef: may ka mashma lan? tenena: tavla yom shelleacharav, veshimmesha et betah, veachar kach raata — bet shammay omrim: metammea mishkavot umoshavot, ufetura min hakkorban!
Amar rav kahana: raata shane.
Amar rav yosef: vechi raata, may have? reiyyay denidda hi!
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: rav kahana hachi ka kashya leh — bishlama hecha deraata, gazrinan reiyyay denidda attu reiyyay dezava, ella hecha dela raata, may nigzar bah?
Veod tenan: haroa reiyyay achat shel zov — bet shammay omrim: keshomeret yom keneged yom, uvet hillel omrim: kevaal keri.
b: Vetanya: hammesit et hariyyay — bet shammay omrim: tolin, uvet hillel metaharin.
Mishkavot umoshavot shebben reiyyay rishona liriyyay sheniyyay, bet shammay tolin, uvet hillel metaharin.
Vekatane resha: haroa reiyyay achat shel zov, bet shammay omrim: keshomeret yom keneged yom. alma shomeret yom keneged yom levet shammay tolin.
La tema "shomeret yom keneged yom", ella ema "kevoel shomeret yom keneged yom".
May shena ihu dela metamme mishkav umoshav, umay shena ihi dimtammeya leh?
Ihu dela shechichi beh damim — la gezur beh rabbanan, ihi dishchichi ba damim — gezur ba rabbanan.
Umay shena mishkav umoshav — dimtammeya leh, umay shena boel — dela metammeya leh?
Mishkav umoshav dishchiach — metammeya leh, boel dela shechiach — la metammeya.
Tenan: tavla yom shelleacharav, veshimmesha — hare zo tarbut raa.
Maggaan uveilatan teluyin. may lav divre hakkol hi?
La, bet hillel hi, detanya: amar lahem rabbi yehuda levet hillel: vechi lazo attem korin tarbut raa? vahalo lo nitkavvevn ze ella livol et hannidda! nidda salka datach?
Ella ema: "livol et hazzava". zava salka datach? ella ema: "livol shomeret yom keneged yom".
Ittemar: asiri, rabbi yochanan amar: asiri kitshii, ma teshii bae shimmur — af asiri bae shimmur.
Resh lakish amar: asiri keachad asar, ma achad asar la bae shimmur — af asiri la bae shimmur.

Ikka dematne la aha, amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya lerabbi akiva: afillu atta merabbe "bashshemen" ["bashshemen"] kol hayyom kullo, eni shomea lecha! ella chatzi log shemen lattoda, ureviit yayin lannazir, veachad asar yom shebben nidda lenidda — halacha lemoshe missinay.
May halacha? rabbi yochanan amar: hilchat achad asar, resh lakish omer: hilchot achad asar.
Rabbi yochanan amar: hilchat achad asar — achad asar hu dela bae shimmur, ha leacharine aved shimmur. veresh lakish amar: hilchot achad asar — la achad asar bae shimmur, vela shimmur laasiri have.
Hane halachot ninhu? hane kerae ninhu! detanya: yachol haroa shelosha yamim bitchillat nidda retzufim tehe zava.
Uma ani mekayyem "ishsha ki tihye zava dam yihye zovah"? beroa yom echad, (aval haroa shelosha yamim battechilla tihye zava), talmud lomar:

a: "Belo et niddatah" (al niddatah) — samuch leniddatah.
Veen li ella samuch leniddatah, mufelag leniddatah yom echad minnayin? talmud lomar: "o ki tazuv".
En li ella yom echad, minnayin lerabbot mufelag shenayim, shelosha, arbaa, chamishsha, shishsha, veshiva, shemona, tisha, asara, minnayin?
Amarta: ma matzinu birvii sherauy lisfira verauy leziva, af ani avi haasiri sherauy lisfira verauy leziva.
Uminnayin lerabbot achad asar? talmud lomar "belo et niddatah". yachol sheani merabbe af shenem asar? amarta: lav.
Uma raita lerabbot achad asar ulehotzi shenem asar? merabbe ani achad asar — sherauy lisfirat "o chi tazuv", umotzi ani shenem asar — sheen rauy lisfirat "o chi tazuv".
Veen li ella shelosha yamim, shene yamim minnayin? talmud lomar "yeme", yom echad minnayin? talmud lomar "kol yeme".
"Temea" — melammed shemmetammea et boalah kenidda. "hi" — hi metammea et boalah, veen hazzav metamme ma shehu boel.

Vahalo din hu, uma hi sheenah metammea biriyyot kivyamim — metammea et boalah, hu shemmetamme biriyyot kivyamim — eno din shemmetamme ma shehu boel! talmud lomar: "hi" — hi metammea et boalah, veen hazzav metamme ma shehu boel.
Uminnayin shehu ose mishkav umoshav? talmud lomar: "kemishkav niddatah".
Veen li ella shelosha yamim, shene yamim minnayin? talmud lomar "yeme", yom echad minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol yeme".

Uminnayin shessoferet echad leechad? talmud lomar: "yihye lah". yachol tispor shiva lishnayim? vedin hu: uma hu, sheen sofer echad leechad, sofer shiva lishnayim — hi, shessoferet echad leechad, eno din shettispor shiva lishnayim? talmud lomar: "yihye lah" — enah soferet ella yomah.
Alma kerae ninhu! lerabbi akiva — kerae, lerabbi elazar ben azarya — hilcheta.
Amar leh rav shemaya lerabbi abba: ema, bimama tihve zava, belelya tihve nidda! amar leh: alach amar kera "al niddatah" — samuch leniddatah. samuch leniddatah emat have? belelya, veka kare la zava.
Tana deve eliyyahu: kol hashshone halachot bechol yom, muvetach lo shehu ben haolam habba, shenneemar "halichot olam lo", al tikre "halichot" ella halachot.
Hadaran alach tinoket, uselika la massechet nidda.
